_readme: Manual additions and corrections, applied AFTER the upstream sync. Keys are '<provider>/<model_id>' exactly like the table entries. Use this file for (a) vendors the upstream sources ignore — e.g. Baidu ERNIE, InternLM, Kunlun — and (b) verified corrections to synced fields. Manual values always win over upstream data and survive weekly re-syncs. Contract: facts only, USD per MTok, absent field == unknown (omit it, never null). Example entry: 'baidu/ernie-5.0': {'provider': 'baidu', 'context_window': 128000, 'tool_call': true, 'cost': {'input_per_mtok': 0.6, 'output_per_mtok': 2.4}} — verify every value against the vendor's official docs/console before committing.
